AntiPattern.Bad: Agent finishes the install steps and reports «Storybook configured» based solely on `npm install` exit code, without booting `storybook dev` or running any story test.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Setup declared complete without end-to-end verification (`AX_SB_VERIFY_BEFORE_HANDOFF`). Misses Playwright browser missing, MCP server not registered, addon misconfigured, port conflict — all of which compile fine but break the first real use.
AntiPattern.Good: Boot `storybook dev` and confirm preview URL responds; call one MCP tool; run `run-story-tests` on one story. If any fails, surface the exact error to the operator before marking the ticket complete.
